_meta.description: AGOS hackathon MVP seed data (docs/data-model.md). All 18 Cabuyao barangays represented with multiple streets each where OSM has them (15 of 18 barangays have 4-5 streets; Marinig has 3; Niugan has 2; Casile has 1 due to genuinely sparse OSM street-level tagging there). Street identity/location is real (verified via OpenStreetMap + Nominatim reverse geocoding + SRTM elevation); rainfall/elevation VALUES are illustrative sample inputs for the demo, not live sensor or CDRRMO-validated readings (see docs/scope.md, out of scope). Rainfall is the same for every street within one barangay (a broad-area illustrative input, not something with real street-level granularity). risk_score/status/risk_rank/predicted_at_risk are NOT stored here - backend/seed.py computes them from these raw inputs via backend/illustrative_scoring.py.
